response.original_title: Baubo and the Belly Button Band
response.overview: Baubo and her belly-buttoned bandmates, Lipstick and Cake, throw a rocking concert to earn the love of their evil, belly-button-less, high-school classmates. The director of this wacky animated film doesn’t handle her characters with kid gloves (in fact, they’re subjected to cruel bullying), but all’s well that ends well because, as she points out, we’re all unique but nobody’s perfect.
response.title: Baubo and the Belly Button Band
